<details class="showcase-notes">
<summary>Model card: Model Showcase: Model Cards &amp; Results · slide 16</summary>

**Table.** This selection transcribes three figures in the model card rather than a single numbered table. Both generations use the effort stated on each row. Datacurve measures DeepSWE pass@1 in mini-swe-agent. Proximal reports FrontierSWE V2 mean@5 partial credit using its Proximus harness. Abundant AI reports SWE-Marathon resolution in native agent harnesses. The protocols and denominators differ between rows. [Grok 4.7 Model Card · §§2.2, 2.4–2.5](https://media.x.ai/v1/website/card4p7-3a96f40b.pdf#page=8).

**Figure.** xAI, “Reasoning Effort Evals”, sample task with 30 short fictional support tickets. These are approximate mean reasoning-token counts per answer. The three higher efforts each used about 600 tokens. Bar scale runs from 0 to 600 tokens. [Primary source](https://docs.x.ai/cookbook/examples/reasoning-effort-evals).

Architecture is Partial because xAI describes a new, larger base model, without specifying parameter count or dense versus MoE topology. The approximately 2.1T estimate is a rumor and is omitted. Data is Not disclosed in the summary even though a May 2026 cutoff is documented: a cutoff is not a corpus description. Alleged SpaceX data are also labeled a rumor in the workbook.

The API supports 500,000 context tokens and low, medium, high and xhigh effort, with high as default and no reasoning-off mode. Base pricing is $2 input and $6 output per million tokens, with $0.50 cached input; requests above 200K context cost more. The platform tools in the card are hosted integrations, not architectural components of the checkpoint. The longer RL run, harder task mixture and Grok Bot familiarity remain vendor-level training descriptions, so Training stays Partial. The multi-agent and compaction documentation does not establish a reproducible native multi-agent training recipe.

**Snapshot and provenance.** LLM_v1.0.xlsx, sheet “Grok 4.7”, audit dated 18.10.2026. Category statuses follow “Сводка”: Architecture: Partial; Data: Not disclosed; Training: Partial; Inference: Known; Tools: Known. Known means a model-specific fact is disclosed, not that the whole category is complete. These slides summarize the supplied audit and do not constitute a fresh independent verification. Prices, limits and availability refer to that snapshot.

**Source rows:** 1, 2, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 19, 20, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 31, 38, 39, 40, 41.

**Sources:** [xAI announcement](https://x.ai/news/grok-4-7), [Model documentation](https://docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.7), [Platform tools](https://docs.x.ai/developers/tools/overview).

</details>

<details class="showcase-notes">
<summary>Results: Model Showcase: Model Cards &amp; Results · slide 17</summary>

The live-mode cookbook uses grok-4.7 at low, medium, high and xhigh effort. The duplicate-charge case is a paraphrase of the published sample with its reference labels, separate from the outputs visible in the dashboard recording. The authors report approximately 140 reasoning tokens per low-effort answer versus approximately 600 at the higher settings. Their batch example uses a different model and is excluded.

[xAI · Reasoning Effort Evals](https://docs.x.ai/cookbook/examples/reasoning-effort-evals).

</details>
